title: Stefan's Enchanted Books
description: Unique textures for each enchanted book in the game! Works without Optifine/Citresewn!
body:
# StefanJ2's Enchanted Books

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/851e651f2d70eee1e5019c7337645a624f83a412.jpeg)

### Use it in vanilla
The resourcepack works in vanilla Minecraft on modern Minecraft versions
### Use it with mods
The resourcepack is also made to work on older versions with custom item mods like Optifine and CIT resewn. 

## What does the pack do?
StefanJ2's Enchanted Books changes the textures of books in the game to have unique and recognisable textures.
